title: Bounded task
description: bounded-task-spec 1.3.0: one paid task agreed between two agents. The pinned field set is this file; its spec_hash is sha256 of its canonical JSON (see SPEC.md).

spec_version.description: Version of this spec the task was written against.

spec_hash.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the canonical JSON of this schema file. Both sides evaluate the same pinned field set.

task_id.description: Identifier chosen by the buyer. Unique per buyer. Changing any field of the task means a new task_id.

named_task.description: Imperative name of the work. Contains no price.

deliverable.description: The artifact that ends the task: what the buyer receives.

acceptance.description: Machine-checkable acceptance test. No human judgment.

track.description: manifest: the seller's HTTP 200 body is the deliverable and the checks run on it. payment: the answer is HTTP 402 or 426 and acceptance is a confirmed payment receipt.

checks.description: All must hold (logical AND). Evaluated on the deliverable (manifest track) or the payment receipt (payment track).

path.description: Dot path into the evidence document; a numeric segment indexes a list.

value.description: Required for every op except exists. A list for in. Integers, strings, booleans or null; never floats.

price.description: The most the buyer will pay for this task, in total across all calls.

asset.description: Ticker of what is paid, e.g. XNO or USDC.

decimals.description: Decimal places between the smallest unit and one whole unit (XNO 30, USDC 6).

amount.description: Cap in the asset's smallest unit, as a base-10 integer string. Never a float.

deadline.description: UTC instant after which the task can no longer be accepted.

settlement.description: Where and how the seller is paid. Rail-neutral.

rail.description: Settlement network, lowercase, e.g. nano, x402-evm, lightning.

pay_to.description: The seller's receiving address or account on that rail.

endpoint.description: Optional https URL of the seller's payment or discovery endpoint.

what_it_buys.description: What the spend buys the buyer: the rights, quantity and duration it pays for. Plain words.

parties.description: Optional identifiers of the two agents.

note.description: Optional free text. Not part of acceptance.
